title: SpectrumQuant: Spectrum Alignment for LLM Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.20303v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Orthogonal transforms have emerged as an effective tool for low-bit quantization of large language models (LLMs), as they reshape activation distributions without changing the underlying model function. Existing approaches typically rely either on fixed data-agnostic transforms, such as Hadamard rotations, or on calibration-time optimization of learned rotations. We study rotation selection from first principles and show that maximizing covariance leads to spectral alignment and provides a principled criterion for constructing quantization-friendly orthogonal transforms. Based on this insight, we propose SpectrumQuant, a closed-form rotation method that estimates activation covariance from calibration data and uses it to construct a covariance-aware orthogonal transform for post-training quantization. Our formulation characterizes quantization-friendly rotations as compositions of alignment and mixing components, while recovering Hadamar

translated_title: SpectrumQuant：面向大语言模型量化的频谱对齐方法
translated_abstract: 正交变换已成为大语言模型（LLM）低比特量化的有效工具，因为它能够在不改变底层模型函数的情况下重塑激活分布。现有方法通常依赖于固定的、与数据无关的变换（如Hadamard旋转），或者依赖于在校准阶段对可学习旋转的优化。我们从第一性原理出发研究旋转选择问题，并证明最大化协方差可以带来频谱对齐，从而为构建量化友好的正交变换提供了一个有理论依据的准则。基于这一洞察，我们提出了SpectrumQuant，这是一种闭式解的旋转方法，它从校准数据中估计激活协方差，并利用它构建协方差感知的正交变换以用于训练后量化。我们的公式化将量化友好的旋转刻画为对齐分量与混合分量的组合，同时将Hadamard旋转作为特例恢复出来（此句原文被截断）。
tldr: 提出SpectrumQuant，一种基于协方差最大化的闭式正交旋转方法，通过频谱对齐构建量化友好的变换，从而提升大语言模型训练后低比特量化的效果。
en_tdlr: SpectrumQuant proposes a closed-form, covariance-aware orthogonal rotation that maximizes spectral alignment to construct quantization-friendly transforms for improved low-bit post-training quantization of LLMs.
